1.consolidated_definition: der. Prueba de propiedad. Documento que acredita la posesión legal de algún bien. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Todo piloto es responsable de tener y mantener en todo momento un proof of ownership (Club de corredores del circuito de )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Proof of ownership: Derivative term referring to a document that verifies the legal possession of some asset. Anglicism, somewhat uncommon. Every pilot is responsible for having and maintaining at all times a proof of ownership (Circuit Drivers' Club)
